about.title: About EXCELLIA
about.subtitle: Learn more about our story, mission, and values
about.story_text1: We are three Algerian friends brought together by a shared vision. Today, two of us live in Turkey and one in Germany, but our connection to our home country has always remained strong.
about.story_text2: With backgrounds in psychology and years of experience working with children, we have seen the importance of early childhood in shaping confident, independent, and emotionally balanced individuals.
about.story_text3: Inspired by what we learned abroad, we decided to bring this vision back to Algeria by creating a kindergarten that offers a nurturing, stimulating, and child-centered environment. This project is more than an investment—it is our way of contributing to the future of our country, by supporting the growth and well-being of its youngest generation.
about.method_text1: The Montessori Method is alternative education that protects and expands the absorbent mind of children through uninterrupted work time. Our kindergarten honors this method, which prepares children for rigorous academics and nurtures their innate creativity.
about.method_text2: Learn more about our objective and curriculum below or contact us today to schedule a tour of our beautiful kindergarten.
about.goals_text1: At our EXCELLIA kindergarten, our purpose is to nurture each child's natural curiosity, independence, and love of learning in a respectful and carefully prepared environment. We believe that every child is unique and capable of developing at their own rhythm when given the right guidance and freedom.
about.goals_text2: We are committed to supporting the whole child—intellectually, emotionally, socially, and physically—through hands-on learning, purposeful activities, and meaningful exploration. Our goal is not only to teach, but to help children build confidence, self-discipline, and a strong sense of responsibility. We strive to create a warm and inclusive community where children feel safe, valued, and encouraged to express themselves.
about.curriculum_subtitle: Our private kindergarten curriculum goes beyond reading, writing, math, and science: We prepare children for life. With our "whole child" approach, we place equal emphasis on each child's social, emotional, physical, spiritual, and cognitive growth.
about.mission_text: To provide a safe, stimulating, and inclusive learning environment that nurtures each child's intellectual, emotional, and social development, preparing them for lifelong success.
about.vision_text: To be a leading educational institution recognized for excellence in early childhood education, producing confident, compassionate, and creative future leaders.
about.cta_text: Give your child the best start in life with our quality education programs
